insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ezreal? They go Ashe
insights.text: Ezreal is a G1 favorite (8/25 G1s, played by Brance). In the 8 later games where it was burned or banned, Brance went to Ashe (2/8) and Zeri (1/8).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Jax is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Jax in 22/63 games (35%): 0 picks (0-0) and 22 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 20 G3+ games, 23/100 picks (23%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 56 champs in G1s, 54 in G3+.
